# humanoid-kit

> Parametric human figures for three.js and React Three Fiber: one CC0 base mesh
> for every age from 1 to 90, a serializable recipe with independent regional
> traits, Catmull-Clark subdivision in a Web Worker, and an enforced age policy
> that keeps adult anatomy in a separate package. Pre-release; the API is in
> development. Clothing and animation are roadmap items, not implemented.

## Packages

- `humanoid-kit` (MIT): loading, recipes, age policy, evaluation, worker client,
  React bindings (`humanoid-kit/react`). `humanoid-kit/editor` is declared but
  not implemented.
- `humanoid-kit-body` (CC0 1.0): base mesh, shape targets, skeleton, skin
  weights, facial pose units, shape modifiers.
- `humanoid-kit-adult-anatomy` (CC0 1.0): adult-only targets; separate install,
  refused unless built against the exact body pack.
- `humanoid-kit-animations` (CC0 1.0): 90 clips (walks, jog, sprint, idles, swims, combat, sitting) on the default
  skeleton, played on any figure with root motion and planted feet derived from the
  figure's own legs; separate install, a clip's file loads when first played.
- `humanoid-kit-hair` (CC0 1.0): ten scalp hair styles as alpha cards bound to
  the base body; separate install, a style's files load when worn, refused
  unless built against the exact body pack. `recipe.hair` picks style and colour.
- `humanoid-kit-clothing` (CC0 1.0): 19 MakeHuman garments bound to the base
  mesh, worn through `recipe.outfit`; separate install, refused unless built
  against the exact body pack.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jbcom.github.io/humanoid-kit/): the published,
  browsable version of everything below.
- [Playground](https://jbcom.github.io/humanoid-kit/playground/): the library's
  own demo (body and hair packs).
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/humanoid-kit/blob/main/README.md): what works
  today, packages, install, quick start, age policy, roadmap.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/humanoid-kit/blob/main/docs/API.md):
  every export of the entry points that exist, and the pack exports.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/humanoid-kit/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  the base mesh, packs, recipe and regions, age policy, evaluation pipeline,
  subdivision, worker and layers.
- [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/jbcom/humanoid-kit/blob/main/NOTICE.md):
  provenance, the CC0 licence gate and trademark notice.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/humanoid-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  toolchain, invariants not to violate, doc/test sync obligations and known gaps
  for an autonomous coding agent working in this repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/humanoid-kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  local setup, the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
